preconditions.description: The number of levels n and the number of operations m are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(op, list) and len(op) in [3, 5] for op in operations)
preconditions.description: Each operation line is parsed into a list of integers with length 3 (type 2) or 5 (type 1).

preconditions.expression: all((op[0] == 1 and 1 <= op[1] <= n and 1 <= op[2] <= op[3] <= cnt[op[1]] and 1 <= op[4] <= 10**6) or (op[0] == 2 and 1 <= op[1] <= n and 1 <= op[2] <= cnt[op[1]]) for op in operations)
preconditions.description: Type 1 operations have valid level t, range [l, r] within the level's vertex count, and valid x. Type 2 operations have valid level t and vertex v within the level's vertex count.

preconditions.expression: cnt[1] == 1 and all(cnt[level+1] == sum(2 if (pos & (pos-1) == 0) else 1 for pos in range(1, cnt[level]+1)) for level in range(1, n))
preconditions.description: The array cnt correctly represents the number of vertices at each level based on the tree construction rules (power of two positions have 2 children, others have 1).

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) == sum(1 for op in operations if op[0] == 2)
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of type 2 operations.

postconditions.expression: all(is_union_size_correct(op, output_lines[idx]) for idx, op in enumerate(operations) if op[0] == 2)
postconditions.description: For each type 2 operation, the corresponding output line is the size of the union of all sets in the subtree of the specified vertex.
